title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 3 · Hall with hidden pit

sourceRecords.title: 10 · Hall and hidden pit · area 3
read: A dusty stone hall runs toward copper-covered double doors. Old decorative columns break up the walls.

The hall gives you a direct way forward, but its floor deserves as much attention as its far end. Dust, joins in the stone, and the places where boots might fall are visible things to inspect. You can slow the group or check the route without assuming that the way is safe.

brief: Somber straight stone hallway. Thick dust covers an intact flagstone floor. Faux columns every ten feet along the walls. Tarnished green copper double doors at the west end carry a mournful angel relief. Oil lamps. The pit is still concealed: NO gap, cracks outlining it, warning markings, missing tiles or visible mechanisms. Empty corridor.
